BiblicalUsage: Jashubi-lehem is named once, among the ancient men of Judah who had dominion in Moab. He stands with Jokim and the men of Chozeba and Joash and Saraph, and the record calls these ancient things.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps the ancient things, and a name from the days of Moab is still written down.
